name: kanotoba-api
description: Kanotoba backend API and Cloudflare D1 database tools

scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply kanotoba-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply kanotoba-db --remote
scripts.db:import:local: npm run import:kanji && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:import:remote: npm run import:kanji && npm run db:seed:remote
scripts.test: node --test tests/worker.test.mjs tests/grammar-api.test.mjs tests/quiz-api.test.mjs tests/grammar-content.test.mjs tests/preview-access.test.mjs
scripts.db:import:grammar:local: npm run import:grammar && npm run db:seed:grammar:local
scripts.db:import:grammar:remote: npm run import:grammar && npm run db:seed:grammar:remote
scripts.db:migrations:list:local: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations list kanotoba-db --local
scripts.db:migrations:list:remote: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations list kanotoba-db --remote
